up: List all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4316584. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, name (pref_name), max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. The document is identified by its ChEMBL ID (docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4316584'). Compounds are linked to the document through compound_records. Sort the results by the compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase AS max_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4316584' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
